rv.q: Heated Rivalry: The Unauthorized Musical Parody is a mirthful and pleasant diversion.
Thoroughly enjoyable, knowingly silly, and affectionate without becoming smug, Heated Rivalry: The Unauthorized Musical Parody understands precisely what fandom wants from a send-up like this.

cn.t: Critics praise this exuberant parody for delivering raunchy humor and Broadway-caliber performances from leads Jay Armstrong Johnson and Jimin Moon, who nail their character impersonations in a campy 80-minute romp that knows its audience and gives fans what they want.
